posts.text: Hey there #PalmBeach! I will be @RaptisRareBooks this Friday, May 8th to sign your copies of #TheCaseForAmerica! I can't wait to meet you-- check it out here: eventbrite.com/e/bret-baier-…

On with @DanaPerino and @BillHemmer for @AmericaNewsroom this morning to discuss #Iran and my new book, The Case For America, out today wherever books are sold #America250

Video

Good morning! I’m excited because today my new book hits bookstores and online retailers— thank you to my @foxnews colleagues for your support and I hope you will check it out and let me know what you think. If you head over to thecaseforamerica.com you can record your own #CaseForAmerica and I’ll send 100 of you a signed book! #america250

Video
Wow…what can I say, you really never know what you’re going to get from @The Five. Thanks @Dana Perino, @Jesse Watters, @Gutfeld! #foxnews #song #weirdtok
My new book officially comes out today! A huge thank you to everyone who sent in their cases for America. Make sure to order your copy today! #caseforamerica #book #america250
Thank you @Bill Hemmer for joining my panel tonight and sharing your thoughts on the war in Iran #panel #specialreport

While the S&P and NASDAQ hit record highs, high gas prices and daily costs continue to fuel a disconnect between Wall Street performance and financial reality facing many American families. #economy #specialreport

It's finally here! My new book officially launches today, and I couldn't be more thrilled! A massive thank you to everyone who helped bring this book to life. Your contributions made it truly special. Make sure to grab your copy today! #caseforamerica #book #america250 #newrelease #mustread

It’s officially book launch day! I’m celebrating right here in Times Square, NYC! 🗽 Make sure to share YOUR case for America at thecaseforamerica.com or order your copy today. #newbook #launchday #booktok #america250 #timessquare

My new book The Case for America comes out TOMORROW. Be sure to visit thecaseforamerica.com to make YOUR case for America today to win a free signed copy of the book #book #caseforamerica #booktok #america250
